devdoc.author: Swarm
devdoc.details: This contract extends BaseBundleTokenCCIP, AnnualFees, and WhitelistedAssets to manage gold assets and fees.

params.arrayLength: The length of the array that caused the error.

params.assetAddress: The address of the asset that was not found.

FnSelectorNotRecognized().details: The function selector is not recognized.

InvalidRole().details: The role has exceeded the maximum role.

NewOwnerIsZeroAddress().details: The `newOwner` cannot be the zero address.

NoHandoverRequest().details: The `pendingOwner` does not have a valid handover request.

params.requiredAmount: The required amount of tokens to dissolve.

params.notWhitelistedAsset: The address of the asset that is not whitelisted.

Permit2AllowanceIsFixedAtInfinity().details: The allowance of Permit2 is fixed at infinity.

RoleHolderIsZeroAddress().details: Cannot set the role of the zero address.

RoleHoldersIndexOutOfBounds().details: The index is out of bounds of the role holders array.

Unauthorized().details: The caller is not authorized to call the function.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `amount` tokens is approved by `owner` to be used by `spender`.

AssetMoved(address,address,address,uint2.details: Emitted when an asset is moved between addresses.

params.amount: The amount of the asset (1 for NFTs, more for fungible assets).
params.assetAddress: The contract address of the asset.
params.assetType: The type of the asset (ERC721, ERC1155, etc.).
params.from: The address from which the asset is moved.
params.to: The address to which the asset is moved.
params.tokenId: The token ID of the asset.

AssetRemovedFromWhitelist(address).details: Emitted when an asset is removed from the whitelist.

params.asset: The address of the asset that was removed from the whitelist.

AssetWhitelisted(address).details: Emitted when a new asset is added to the whitelist.

params.asset: The address of the asset that was whitelisted.

BundleConfiguredAndFinalized(address,uin.details: Emitted when the bundle token is configured and finalized.

params._initialMintAmount: The initial amount of tokens minted.
params._tokenKya: The KYA (Know Your Asset) document or reference.
params.at: The timestamp when the bundle was finalized.
params.owner: The address of the bundle owner.

BundleDeactivated(address,uint256).details: Emitted when the bundle is deactivated.

params.at: The timestamp when the bundle was deactivated.
params.caller: The address that deactivated the bundle.

BundleKyaChanged(address,string).details: Emitted when the bundle's KYA is updated.

params.by: The address that updated the KYA.
params.kya: The new KYA document or reference.

BundleStorageChanged(address,address).details: Emitted when the bundle storage contract is updated.

params.by: The address that changed the storage.
params.newBundleStorage: The new address of the BundleStorage contract.

InitialAssetsAdded(address,uint256).details: Emitted when initial ERC721 assets are added to the bundle.

params.at: The timestamp when the assets were added.
params.from: The address that added the assets.

OwnershipHandoverCanceled(address).details: The ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been canceled.

OwnershipHandoverRequested(address).details: An ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been requested.

OwnershipTransferred(address,address).details: The ownership is transferred from `oldOwner` to `newOwner`. This event is intentionally kept the same as OpenZeppelin's Ownable to be compatible with indexers and [EIP-173](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-173), despite it not being as lightweight as a single argument event.

RoleSet(address,uint256,bool).details: The status of `role` for `holder` has been set to `active`.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `amount` tokens is transferred from `from` to `to`.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the EIP-712 domain separator for the EIP-2612 permit.

addAssetsToList(address[],string[]).details: Only the contract owner can execute this function.

params.assets: Array of asset addresses to whitelist.
params.assetsWeight: Corresponding weights of the assets in string format.

addNewAssets((address,uint256,uint256,ui.details: Assets must be whitelisted before being added. Mints tokens based on asset weights.

params.assets: An array of `Asset` structs representing the assets to be added.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the amount of tokens that `spender` can spend on behalf of `owner`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens. Emits a {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `owner`.

burn(uint256).details: Only accounts with the BURNER role can call this function.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to burn from the caller's balance.

cancelOwnershipHandover().details: Cancels the two-step ownership handover to the caller, if any.

changeBundleStorage(address).details: Only the contract owner can change the bundle storage.

params.newBundleStorage: The address of the new BundleStorage contract.

completeOwnershipHandover(address).details: Allows the owner to complete the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`. Reverts if there is no existing ownership handover requested by `pendingOwner`.

constructor.details: Sets up the bundle storage, whitelists assets, assigns weights, and initializes ownership.

params._bundleStorage: The address of the BundleStorage contract.
params._tokenKya: The Know Your Asset (KYA) document reference.
params.assets: An array of asset addresses to whitelist.
params.assetsWeight: An array of corresponding asset weights in string format.

decimals().details: Returns the decimals places of the token.

mint(address,uint256).details: Only accounts with the MINTER role can call this function.

params.account: The address that will receive the minted tokens.
params.amount: The amount of tokens to mint.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value is used to compute the signature for EIP-2612 permit.

owner().details: Returns the owner of the contract.

ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(address).details: Returns the expiry timestamp for the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over the tokens of `owner`, authorized by a signed approval by `owner`. Emits a {Approval} event.

removeListedAsset(address).details: Only the contract owner can remove an asset.

params.asset: The address of the asset to remove.

renounceOwnership().details: Allows the owner to renounce their ownership.

requestOwnershipHandover().details: Request a two-step ownership handover to the caller. The request will automatically expire in 48 hours (172800 seconds) by default.

roleHolderAt(uint256,uint256).details: Returns the holder of `role` at the index `i`.

roleHolderCount(uint256).details: Returns the total number of holders of `role`.

roleHolders(uint256).details: Returns an array of the holders of `role`.

setRole(address,uint256,bool).details: Sets the status of `role` of `holder` to `active`.

totalSupply().details: Returns the amount of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Transfer `amount` tokens from the caller to `to`. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` tokens from `from` to `to`. Note: Does not update the allowance if it is the maximum uint256 value. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. - The caller must have at least `amount` of allowance to transfer the tokens of `from`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferOwnership(address).details: Allows the owner to transfer the ownership to `newOwner`.

updateKYA(string).details: Only the contract owner can update the KYA document.

withdrawAssets((address,uint256,uint256,.details: Assets must be whitelisted before withdrawal.

params.assets: An array of `Asset` structs representing the assets to withdraw.

ArraySizeError(uint256).notice: Error thrown when the size of an array is invalid.

ArraySizesDifferent().notice: Error thrown when two arrays have different sizes.

AssetNotFound(address).notice: Thrown when the asset is not found in a list.

GoldAssetNotAdded(address).notice: Error thrown when attempting to remove a non-existent gold asset.

GoldAssetsErrorType().notice: Error thrown when an unsupported gold asset type is encountered.

IncorrectAssetType(uint8).notice: Thrown when an incorrect asset type is provided.

NotEnoughTokensToDissolve(uint256,uint25.notice: Thrown when the sender doesn't have enough tokens to dissolve the bundle.

NotWhitelisted(address).notice: Error thrown when a non-whitelisted asset is used.

GoldAssetAdded(address,string).notice: Event emitted when a gold asset is added.

GoldAssetRemoved(address,uint256).notice: Event emitted when a gold asset is removed.

ONE_GOLD_KILO_IN_OUNCES().notice: Represents 1 gold kilogram in ounces (18 decimals precision).

ONE_GOLD_OUNCE().notice: Represents 1 gold ounce in wei (18 decimals precision).

addAssetsToList(address[],string[]).notice: Whitelists new assets and assigns their weights.

addNewAssets((address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Adds new assets to the bundle.

assetToWeight(address).notice: Mapping of asset addresses to their weight in gold.

assetsInBundle(uint256).notice: The list of assets contained within the bundle.

bundleStorage().notice: The address of the BundleStorage contract managing asset data.

burn(uint256).notice: Burns a specified amount of tokens from the sender's balance.

changeBundleStorage(address).notice: Changes the BundleStorage contract associated with this bundle.

dissolve().notice: Dissolves the bundle, effectively closing it.

lastOperationTimestamp().notice: The timestamp of the last operation (deposit, withdraw) involving this bundle.

mint(address,uint256).notice: Mints a specified amount of tokens to a given address.

name().notice: Returns the name of the bundle token.

removeListedAsset(address).notice: Removes an asset from the whitelist.

symbol().notice: Returns the symbol of the bundle token.

tokenKya().notice: Returns the KYA (Know Your Asset) document of the bundle token.

updateKYA(string).notice: Updates the Know Your Asset (KYA) document for the bundle.

whitelistedAssets(uint256).notice: The list of currently whitelisted asset addresses.

withdrawAssets((address,uint256,uint256,.notice: Withdraws assets from the bundle and burns corresponding tokens.

userdoc.notice: This contract represents a bundle of xGold tokens, where 1 token represents 1 ounce of gold.
